meta.title: Mizan
meta.description: Mizan — the commerce operating system: orders, confirmation, shipping, warehouse and real profit in one place.

home.title: Welcome to Mizan
home.subtitle: Connect your store to see your orders and your real profit in one place.

empty.title: No orders yet
empty.body: Once you connect a Shopify store, we import the last {days} days of orders and all your products.

auth.title: Sign in to Mizan
auth.subtitle: Store owners and admins sign in with email and a code on their phone. Confirmation and warehouse teams can use their phone number.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured in this build.
auth.resetSent: We sent a password reset link to <e>{email}</e>.

mfa.title: Second step
mfa.body: We texted a code to the number ending in <n>{hint}</n>.

auth.enrolled: Two-step verification is on. Sign in again with your email and a code.

errors.invalidCredential: That email or password is not right.
errors.emailInUse: This email already has an account. Sign in with it.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too short. Use 8 characters or more.
errors.invalidPhone: That phone number is not valid. Write it like 01001234821.
errors.invalidCode: That code is wrong. Check the message and type it again.
errors.codeExpired: That code expired. Send a new one.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check the internet and try again.

twoStep.title: Turn on two-step verification
twoStep.body: To protect your store, owners and admins sign in with email and a code sent to their phone.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email first
verifyEmail.body: We will send a confirmation link to <e>{email}</e>. Open it, then come back here.
verifyEmail.notYet: Your email is not confirmed yet. Open the link in the message.

twoStep.phoneAccount: This account signs in with a phone number. Store owners need an email account to turn on the second step.
twoStep.recentLogin: For your security, sign out, sign in again, then turn on the second step.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.subtitle: Open a store you were invited to, or create your own.

create.title: Create a store
create.name: Store name
create.countryHint: We set the currency, time zone and phone format from the country.

errors.tenantLimit: You have reached the store limit.
errors.generic: We couldn't create the store. Try again.

gate.unavailable: We can't reach your store right now.

palette.label: Search or jump to
palette.placeholder: Type a page or an action…

gallery.title: UI kit
gallery.subtitle: Every component of the dashboard, from the design system's recipes, in the current language and theme. Sample data only.

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.body: One primary (ink) action per screen. Red only for the one commercial moment. Destructive actions ask first.

fields.title: Fields
fields.body: Label above, hint below; the error replaces the hint and says how to fix it.
fields.name: Store name
fields.phoneError: This number is too short. Egyptian mobiles have 11 digits.
fields.cityEmpty: No city matches. Check the spelling.
fields.autoConfirmHint: Orders with a risk under 40 skip the call.

statusSection.title: Status and payment
statusSection.body: Badges always carry words; colour is never the only signal. Payment methods are tags with their icon.

risk.label: Risk {score} of 100
risk.reasons: Two refused orders on this number in 60 days; address without a landmark.

kpis.title: Summary tiles
kpis.body: The hero tile is the number the screen exists for. Green and red follow meaning: a falling return rate is good news.

table.title: Table
table.body: Sticky header, sortable columns, row selection with bulk actions. Numbers at the end, ids left to right.
table.label: Sample orders

empty.title: No orders here
empty.body: Orders that need this step will show here as they arrive.
empty.returnsBody: When a courier brings a parcel back, it shows here for checking and restocking.

toast.shipped: {count, plural, one {# order shipped with Bosta} other {# orders shipped with Bosta}}

panel.title: Side panel
panel.body: Key facts as a label-value list and the history, newest first. Opens as a drawer on any screen.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.body: Alerts explain and suggest the next step. Toasts confirm what just happened. Loading shows the shape of the content.
feedback.success: We imported 412 orders from the last 60 days.
feedback.warningLead: 3 orders are waiting for a deposit.
feedback.warning: Send the link again or call the customer.
feedback.danger: The city is missing. Pick a city and send again.

dialog.title: Cancel order #{id}?
dialog.body: Bosta will be asked to stop the delivery, and the customer gets a WhatsApp message.

problems.network: No connection to the server. Check the internet and try again.
problems.generic: Something went wrong and we couldn't finish. Try again.

onboarding.title: Set up your store
onboarding.subtitle: Four steps to see your orders and your real profit in Mizan.

ready.title: Your store is ready.
ready.body: Orders arrive on their own from now on.

store.title: Connect your Shopify store
store.body: Mizan imports the last 60 days of orders and all your products, then receives every new order by itself.
store.hint: Write it as it appears in Shopify, like <n>nile-abayas.myshopify.com</n>.
store.importing: Importing: {orders} orders and {products} products so far…
store.invalid: That address doesn't look like a Shopify store. It ends with .myshopify.com.
store.scopesChanged: Mizan needs new Shopify permissions to edit orders (mark them paid and add offers the customer accepted). Approve them once.

courier.title: Connect your courier
courier.body: With Bosta connected, you ship confirmed orders in one click and their status updates by itself.
courier.hint: In Bosta: Settings → API integration → create a key, then paste it here.
courier.refused: Bosta refused this key. Copy it again from Bosta's dashboard and paste it here.
courier.noPermission: This key can't create or read deliveries. Create a key with full access in Bosta.
courier.skipped: Skipped. You can connect Bosta any time.

costs.title: Enter your product costs
costs.body: The cost of each product is what turns sales into real profit. Enter what one piece costs you.
costs.count: {missing} of {total} products have no cost yet.
costs.none: Your products show here after the store import.
costs.saved: {count, plural, one {Cost saved for # product} other {Costs saved for # products}}
costs.invalid: Write the cost as a number, like 250 or 250.50.
costs.skipped: Skipped. Profit uses a cost of zero until you enter it.

firstOrder.title: Your first order
firstOrder.waitingBody: As soon as an order reaches Mizan it shows here. New Shopify orders arrive within a minute.
firstOrder.ttfv: From signing up to your first order: {duration}.

errors.install_cancelled: The connection was cancelled in Shopify. Try again when you're ready.
errors.invalid_signature: Shopify's answer couldn't be verified. Start again from Mizan.
errors.invalid_state: This link expired. Start the connection again from Mizan.
errors.invalid_shop: That isn't a Shopify store address.
errors.scopes_missing: Mizan didn't get all the permissions it needs. Approve every permission in Shopify.
errors.shopify_unavailable: Shopify isn't answering right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.shopify_not_configured: Shopify isn't set up on this server yet.
errors.install_failed: The connection didn't finish. Try again.
errors.missing: This page needs a link from Shopify. Start the connection from Mizan.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Every order from your stores in one list, newest first.
orders.search: Search by order number or customer phone
orders.label: Orders

empty.title: No orders yet
empty.body: Connect your store and your orders show here within a minute.

emptyTab.title: No orders here
emptyTab.body: Orders with this status show here as they arrive.

noMatch.title: No order matches
noMatch.body: Search by order number like #1042, or by the customer's phone.

notFound.title: Order not found
notFound.body: It may be in another store, or not one you can open.

payments.title: Payments
payments.empty: No money has moved on this order yet.

customer.title: Customer
customer.recorded: Viewing is recorded in the activity log.
customer.name: Name
customer.gone: These details were deleted on request.
customer.tooMany: Too many views in a short time. Try again in a minute.
customer.none: No customer details on this order.

risk.title: Risk
risk.notScored: Not scored yet. Scoring comes with confirmation.

confirmation.title: Confirmation

reason.team_call: The customer didn't answer on WhatsApp. Call them.
reason.no_reply: The customer didn't answer. Call them or send the link.
reason.no_channel: WhatsApp isn't connected yet: call the customer or send the link by hand.
reason.change_requested: The customer asked for a change. Call them.
reason.customer_message: The customer wrote on WhatsApp. Call them.
reason.unreachable: Called several times with no answer. Decide whether to keep or cancel.
reason.manual: The link was sent by hand. Waiting for the customer.
reason.high_risk: High risk score: call the customer before anything is sent.
reason.hold: Very high risk score: review this order before confirming it.

confirmation.waiting: Waiting for an answer to {channel}, until
confirmation.noVendor: WhatsApp isn't connected yet: connect it in Settings → Confirmation so customers confirm with one tap in the chat.
confirmation.noPhone: This order has no phone number.
confirmation.cancelBody: The order won't ship. The customer isn't notified automatically.

in.late: Tap after the order was recorded

calls.title: Confirmation call
calls.phoneHint: Reveal the customer's number on the customer card, then call.
calls.retryToast: Done: it comes back on the list at the next call time.
calls.unreachableToast: That was the last try. The order stays on the list as unreachable.

offer.title: Offer
offer.acceptedHint: Mizan is adding it to the store's order now.
offer.applyingHint: Being added to the store's order…
offer.appliedHint: Added to the store's order: the courier collects the new total.

failed.not_in_store: Not added: this order or product isn't in a connected store. Add it by hand and tell the customer.
failed.unavailable: Not added: the item is sold out or no longer in the store, or the order was cancelled. Call the customer.
failed.permission: Not added: the store needs reconnecting to allow order edits (Settings → Integrations). Add it by hand for now.
failed.failed: Not added: the store didn't accept the change. Add it by hand and tell the customer.

toast.accepted: Recorded: the customer accepted the offer
toast.declined: Recorded: the customer declined the offer

profit.title: Profit
profit.movingHint: Counted for real when the money arrives: on delivery for cash, on payment for prepaid.
profit.estimated: Courier and fee costs are estimates from your rates until the courier's settlement arrives.

missing.fx_missing: Exchange rate for this order's currency and day

emptyCalls.title: No one to call right now
emptyCalls.body: Orders whose customer didn't answer on WhatsApp, or asked for a change, show here for your team to call.

emptyDuplicates.title: No possible duplicates
emptyDuplicates.body: When a customer orders the same product again within 48 hours, the order waits here for you to keep or merge it.

duplicate.title: Possible duplicate
duplicate.body: The same customer ordered <order></order> {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} earlier with the same products: {items}. It is held from confirmation until you decide.
duplicate.mergeBody: This order will be cancelled in Mizan as a duplicate of <order></order> and tagged mizan-duplicate in your store. The earlier order goes on as it is.
duplicate.kept: Kept. It goes on to confirmation.
duplicate.merged: Merged. This order is cancelled as a duplicate.
duplicate.wasKept: Kept as a separate order, though it looked like a duplicate of <order></order>.

costs.title: Costs
costs.subtitle: What each order costs beyond its products, so profit is real.
costs.versioning: Changes apply to orders from today (<d></d>). Older orders keep the cost of their day.
costs.readOnly: You can see costs; only the owner, an admin or finance can change them.

notAllowed.title: Costs are for owners and finance
notAllowed.body: Ask the store owner if you need to see them.

costs.saved: Saved. It applies to orders from today.
costs.invalidPercent: Enter a percentage like 1.5 (100 at most)

perOrder.title: Per order
perOrder.body: Costs every order carries, whatever is in it.
perOrder.agentHint: What one confirmed order costs in agent time or commission.

cod.title: Cash on delivery
cod.body: What the courier takes for collecting cash, as a share of the amount collected.

payment.title: Online payment fees
payment.body: What the gateway or wallet keeps per payment: a percentage plus a fixed amount.

courier.title: Courier rate card
courier.body: What each courier charges per delivery and per return. A zone rate wins over the courier's general rate.

monthly.title: Monthly fixed costs
monthly.body: Rent, salaries, subscriptions: spread over the month's orders in the profit view.
monthly.label: What it is

fx.title: Exchange rates
fx.body: Orders in another currency are converted with the rate of the day they were placed. Rates update daily; set your own for a day if your bank's differs.

confirm.title: Confirm your order
confirm.intro: Please confirm your order <n>{number}</n> so we can ship it.

location.share: Share my location for the courier
location.denied: Location wasn't shared. That's fine: the courier will call you.

confirm.changeLabel: What would you like to change?
confirm.privacy: Only you and the store can see this page.

invalid.title: This link doesn't work
invalid.body: Check the message you received, or contact the store.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.body: We couldn't load your order. Try again in a moment.

expired.body: This link has expired. The store will contact you.

confirmed.title: Order confirmed
confirmed.body: Thank you! {store} will ship your order soon.

cancelled.title: Order cancelled
cancelled.body: Your order was cancelled. Nothing will be shipped.

changed.title: We got your request
changed.body: {store} will call you shortly about the change.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: {store} will contact you to confirm your order.

closed.title: Nothing to confirm
closed.body: This order no longer needs your confirmation.

confirmationSettings.title: Confirmation
confirmationSettings.subtitle: How new cash-on-delivery orders get confirmed automatically, before an agent steps in.
confirmationSettings.loadFailed: Couldn't load the settings. Try again.
confirmationSettings.saved: Saved. New orders follow these settings.

notAllowed.title: For owners, admins and ops managers
notAllowed.body: Ask the store owner to change how orders are confirmed.

confirmationSettings.enabledHint: Every new order gets a confirmation request on WhatsApp; the customer confirms, changes or cancels with one tap in the chat. Whoever doesn't answer goes to your team to call.

channels.title: Channels
channels.none: WhatsApp isn't connected yet, so new orders go straight to your team to call. Connect the store's WhatsApp number below.

steps.title: Order of steps
steps.body: Mizan tries each step in order and waits for an answer before the next. A channel that isn't connected is skipped. The team call is always the last step.
steps.agent: If nobody answers: the order goes on the "Needs a call" list
steps.teamLast: The team call must be the last step.

hours.title: Calling hours
hours.body: Calls (automated and by your team) only in these hours, store time. WhatsApp messages go out any time.

link.hint: For the link your team sends by hand when WhatsApp isn't connected.

team.title: Team calls
team.body: When your team calls and nobody answers, the order leaves the list and comes back after this time, up to the number of tries.

whatsapp.title: The store's WhatsApp number
whatsapp.body: Customers confirm their order with one tap in the chat. From your WhatsApp Business account on Meta: the phone number ID, the account ID and a permanent token. The token is stored encrypted and never shown again.
whatsapp.checking: Checking the token and that Meta approved the confirmation message…
whatsapp.phoneNumberIdHint: Digits only, from the API setup page, not the phone number.
whatsapp.tokenHint: A system-user token with whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management.
whatsapp.ownerOnly: Only the owner or an admin can connect WhatsApp.

reason.token_refused: Meta refused the token. Create a new one and enter it again.
reason.token_lacks_permission: The token lacks permissions on this account (whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management).
reason.template_pending: Meta is still reviewing the confirmation message. WhatsApp confirmation starts as soon as it's approved.
reason.template_rejected: Meta rejected the confirmation message. Submit it again with the wording in the setup guide.
reason.template_missing: The confirmation message in the store's language (mizan_order_confirm_ar or mizan_order_confirm_en) isn't in the account. Add it in WhatsApp Manager with the wording in the setup guide.

routing.title: Route by risk
routing.enabled: Route each order by its risk score
routing.enabledHint: Off: every cash order goes through the steps above.
routing.botMax: Ask in the chat up to
routing.order: Each number must be at least the one before
routing.paid: Paid orders are approved unless above the team's number; instalments are approved; a bank transfer waits for its money.

results.title: Results
results.empty: No orders went through confirmation in this period yet.

offersSettings.title: Offers
offersSettings.subtitle: Offer one more item when a customer confirms: inside the WhatsApp chat and in your team's call script.
offersSettings.loadFailed: Couldn't load the settings. Try again.
offersSettings.saved: Saved. New confirmations follow these settings.

notAllowed.title: For the owner, admins and ops managers
notAllowed.body: Ask the store owner to set up offers.

offersSettings.enabled: Offer one more item when the customer confirms
offersSettings.enabledHint: One offer per order: your rules first; when none fits, Mizan suggests what customers buy with the same products.

how.title: How the offer is chosen
how.maxDiscountHint: No offer is ever discounted more than this.
how.autoDiscountHint: On what Mizan suggests. Rules carry their own.
how.overMax: Must be at most the maximum discount
how.inWhatsApp: Offer it in the WhatsApp chat after the customer confirms
how.inCalls: Put it in your team's call script
how.guards: Mizan never offers something already in the order, sold out, sold at a loss after the discount, or priced over 60% of the order.
how.ai: Let AI choose and write the offer
how.aiHint: Claude picks from the same suggestions and writes a short message; Mizan sets the price. Your rules stay as they are; it only writes their message when you didn't. No customer data is sent.

mode.rules_then_auto: My rules first, then Mizan's suggestions

rules.title: Offer rules
rules.body: When the order has a given product, offer another at a discount. A rule for a product beats a rule for any order.
rules.line: If the order has {trigger} → offer {offer} at {pct}% off
rules.none: No rules yet. Mizan suggests on its own if you choose so.
rules.messageHint: Leave it empty and Mizan writes it, like: "🎁 An offer for you: a scarf for EGP 135 instead of EGP 150."

adSpend.title: Ad spend
adSpend.subtitle: What you spend on ads each day. Mizan splits each day's spend over the orders that came in that day, so every order's profit includes its ads.
adSpend.loadFailed: Couldn't load ad spend. Try again.
adSpend.readOnly: You can see ad spend; the owner, an admin or finance can change it.

notAllowed.title: Not for your role
notAllowed.body: Ad spend is for the owner, admins, finance and ops managers.

summary.unallocatedHint: Days with spend and no orders: still a cost

add.title: Enter a day's spend
add.body: Saving replaces what that day and platform had.
add.currencyHint: As the platform charged you; converted at that day's rate
add.saved: Saved. That day's orders now carry it.

import.title: Import a CSV
import.body: A platform's export or your own sheet: a header row with date and spend, plus platform (or choose one below); currency and campaign are optional. Each day and platform in the file replaces what was there.
import.failed: Couldn't import the file. Try again.
import.invalid: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} couldn't be read. Nothing was saved.

problem.header: The header needs date and spend, and platform

days.title: By day
days.empty: No spend in the last 30 days.

entries.title: Entries
entries.removed: Removed. That day's orders were updated.

profitHome.title: Overview
profitHome.subtitle: What your store really kept: every order, every cost, every pound.
profitHome.loadFailed: Couldn't load your profit. Try again.

kept.title: Kept · last {days} days
kept.per100: Of every <hundred></hundred> in revenue, you kept <kept></kept>.
kept.noRevenue: No delivered or paid orders in this period yet: revenue counts when the money is real.
kept.expected: If the orders on their way deliver: <money></money>.

kpi.yesterdayHint: {orders, plural, =0 {No orders} one {# order} other {# orders}}, if they deliver
kpi.refusalsHint: {count, plural, =0 {No refusals} one {# refused order, all costs} other {# refused orders, all costs}}
kpi.cashHint: {transit} on the way · {held} collected, not paid yet

trend.title: Profit per day
trend.hint: What each day's orders make if those on their way deliver. Losses in red.

losing_orders.title: {count, plural, one {# order loses money} other {# orders lose money}}
losing_orders.body: Together <money></money>, even if they deliver. Check their price, product cost and shipping.

refusals.title: {count, plural, one {# refused order} other {# refused orders}}
refusals.body: They cost <money></money>: shipping both ways, ads and fees.

unallocated_ads.title: Ad spend no order carried
unallocated_ads.body: <money></money> on {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} with no orders. Still a cost.

other_currency.title: {count, plural, one {# order in another currency} other {# orders in other currencies}}
other_currency.body: Not in these totals: add the exchange rate for their days.

cost_missing.title: Product cost missing
cost_missing.body: {count, plural, one {# order has} other {# orders have}} a product without a cost: profit is too high.

shipping_rate_missing.title: Courier price missing
shipping_rate_missing.body: {count, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} without a delivery price for their area.

cod_fee_missing.title: COD fee missing
cod_fee_missing.body: {count, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} without the courier's collection fee.

agent_cost_missing.title: Confirmation cost missing
agent_cost_missing.body: {count, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} without the team's cost per order.

packaging_cost_missing.title: Packaging cost missing
packaging_cost_missing.body: {count, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} without a packaging cost.

payment_fee_missing.title: Payment fee missing
payment_fee_missing.body: {count, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} paid online without the gateway's fee.

fx_missing.title: Exchange rate missing
fx_missing.body: {count, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} without a rate for their day.

ads_fx_missing.title: Ad spend without a rate
ads_fx_missing.body: Spend in another currency on {count, plural, one {# order's day} other {the days of # orders}} isn't counted yet.

sync_gap.title: Orders missing from the store sync
sync_gap.body: On {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} the store had a different number of orders than Mizan, even after the nightly check fetched the missing ones. Check the store connection.

newOrder.title: New order
newOrder.subtitle: An order taken on the phone, in WhatsApp or Instagram, or in person. It goes through confirmation like any other.

notAllowed.title: You can't create orders
notAllowed.body: Ask the store owner for the right role.

items.title: Items
items.empty: No items yet. Pick a product above.
items.custom: An item not in the catalogue

mode.partial: Deposit now, the rest on delivery

summary.title: Summary
summary.waitsForTransfer: It won't ship until the transfer arrives.
summary.next: After you create it, confirmation starts as for store orders.
